items.headline: 厄尔尼诺增强，降雨格局怎样变？
items.headline_en: El Niño Strengthens and Shifts Rainfall Risks
items.summary: 世界气象组织预计，正在增强的厄尔尼诺将在12月前后达峰。热带太平洋海温变化会影响全球降雨，增加不同地区的旱涝风险；季节预测并非某地某天的天气预报。
items.summary_en: WMO expects the strengthening El Niño to peak around December. Changing tropical Pacific sea temperatures can shift global rainfall, raising drought and flood risks in different regions. A seasonal outlook describes broad probabilities rather than the weather at one place on a particular day.

items.headline: 软薄片怎样“读出”自己的弯曲？
items.headline_en: A Soft Sheet Senses Its Own Shape
items.summary: MIT展示一种柔软传感薄片：内嵌光纤随弯曲改变透光量，算法据此重建三维形状。原型有望记录康复动作；研究仍处于实验验证阶段，尚未证实临床效果。
items.summary_en: MIT demonstrated a soft sensing sheet whose embedded optical fibres change light transmission as they bend. An algorithm reconstructs its three-dimensional shape from these signals. The prototype could track rehabilitation movements, but clinical benefits have not yet been demonstrated.

items.headline: 病毒的“剪刀”，触发细菌警报
items.headline_en: A Viral Enzyme Triggers a Bacterial Alarm
items.summary: 研究发现，部分噬菌体的蛋白酶会切开细菌感应蛋白，启动抗病毒防线。受感染细菌随后可死亡，阻止病毒扩散。这揭示一种免疫识别机制，为噬菌体疗法提供线索，仍属基础研究。
items.summary_en: Researchers found that proteases in some bacteriophages cut a bacterial sensor, activating antiviral defences. The infected bacterium can then die before the virus spreads. This immune-sensing mechanism may inform phage therapies, but the findings remain basic research.

source.name: 犹他大学 / University of Utah

items.headline: 像线一样细的电机，靠静电滑动
items.headline_en: A Thread-Like Motor Moves Using Electrostatic Forces
items.summary: EPFL团队做出直径约1至3毫米的柔性电机：静电力使内外两层纤维相对滑动。实验中，四根电机合力提起46克巧克力；未来或可用于助力衣物，但性能和耐久性仍需改进。
items.summary_en: EPFL researchers built flexible motors about 1–3 millimetres in diameter. Electrostatic forces slide two nested fibres past each other. In laboratory tests, four motors lifted a 46-gram chocolate bar. Wearable assistance is a possible future use; performance and durability still need improvement.

source.name: 洛桑联邦理工学院 / EPFL

items.headline: 射电暴来源，线索藏在宿主星系
items.headline_en: A Radio Burst's Host Offers Clues to Its Origin
items.summary: 韦布望远镜测得一处快速射电暴宿主星系红移为2.148，对应宇宙约30亿岁时。星系中年轻的恒星群更支持磁星来源解释，但射电暴的产生机制仍未确定。
items.summary_en: Webb measured a fast radio burst's host galaxy at redshift 2.148, corresponding to when the universe was about three billion years old. Its young stellar population favours a magnetar origin, but the mechanism producing the burst remains uncertain.

items.headline: 换一组颜色，看清泰国洪水范围
items.headline_en: False Colour Reveals the Extent of Thailand's Flooding
items.summary: NASA公布的Landsat影像显示，泰国邦巴功河沿岸农田和养殖区10月2日被洪水淹没。把不同波段组合成假彩色图，可更清楚地区分水体与植被，并与去年同期影像比较。
items.summary_en: Landsat images released by NASA show flooding across farmland and aquaculture sites along Thailand's Bang Pakong River on 2 October. Combining different wavelength bands into false-colour images distinguishes water from vegetation more clearly and enables comparison with imagery from the same season last year.

previous_answers.headline:
从1到100的整数中，
任意选出51个不同的数。
证明：其中必有两个数，
一个是另一个的整数倍。
previous_answers.headline_en: Choose any 51 distinct integers from 1 to 100. Prove that one of the chosen numbers must be an integer multiple of another.
previous_answers.result_en: Group the numbers by their odd parts
previous_answers.explanation: 把每个数不断除以2，直到剩下奇数。最多只有50种奇数结果，因此51个数中必有两个得到同一个奇数；这两个原数相差若干次乘2，较小数就整除较大数。
previous_answers.explanation_en: Repeatedly divide each number by 2 until an odd number remains. There are at most 50 possible odd results, so two of the 51 selected numbers must share one. Their original values differ by factors of 2, so the smaller divides the larger.

previous_answers.headline:
反复独立抛一枚公平硬币。
“正正”和“反正”中，
哪一种更可能先连续出现？
求两者各自先出现的概率。
previous_answers.headline_en: Toss a fair coin independently. Which consecutive pattern appears first: HH or TH (H=heads, T=tails)? Find the probability for each pattern.
previous_answers.explanation: HH先出现的概率是1/4，TH是3/4。HH想赢，开头两次必须就是HH；否则先出现了T，之后第一次出现H时，TH就已经赢了。
previous_answers.explanation_en: HH wins with probability 1/4; TH wins with probability 3/4. HH can win only if the first two tosses are HH. Otherwise, a T occurs before any HH, and the first subsequent H completes TH.

previous_answers.headline:
北滘一所大型中学的屋顶，
在一场50毫米暴雨中，
大约能收集多少吨雨水？
给出数值或数量级，
并说明主要假设。
previous_answers.headline_en: Estimate the tonnes of rainwater collected by the roofs of a large secondary school in Beijiao during a 50 mm rainstorm. State your assumptions.
previous_answers.result_en: Sample estimate: about 400 tonnes per rainstorm
previous_answers.explanation: 示例约400吨：假设屋顶水平投影总面积1万平方米、收集率80%，水量为10000×0.05×0.8＝400立方米，约400吨。这是估算示例，面积和收集率并非学校实测数据。
previous_answers.explanation_en: Sample estimate: about 400 tonnes. Assume a total horizontal roof area of 10,000 m² and an 80% collection rate. Collected water is 10,000×0.05×0.8=400 m³, approximately 400 tonnes. The area and collection rate are illustrative assumptions, not measurements of an actual school.

editorial_notes: 2026-10-10 v1，经内容所有者于2026-10-09在聊天中确认并要求发布。
事实核查截止2026-10-09 UTC。六条均为相对10月9日版的新选题；机构新闻发布日期为2026-10-02至2026-10-09，研究发生时间在核查说明中另列。
厄尔尼诺：WMO原文发布日期为2026-10-08，季节展望覆盖10至12月。12月达峰及未来旱涝风险均为预测；不将海温异常写成全球气温，也不把季节概率等同于本地单日天气。
柔性形状传感：MIT报道日期为2026-10-08；论文首次发表为2026-07-29，不能称为当天完成的新发现。已核对机构报道及开放论文的光波导、形状重建与原型实验描述；康复用途属于潜在应用。
细菌免疫：犹他大学报道为2026-10-02，文中注明Science论文发表于10月1日。描述的是部分噬菌体蛋白酶激活CBASS的机制，非所有细菌的通用防御，亦非临床疗效结论。论文链接已核验，全文直接访问返回403。
纤维电机：EPFL报道为2026-10-07；论文首次发表为2026-09-27。四根电机提起46克为实验演示，不能与单根静态承重混用。论文说明原型连接外部高压电源；不能写成已可直接日常穿戴的成熟产品。
快速射电暴：NASA报道为2026-10-08；射电暴最早于2024-03-04被探测。红移2.148对应大爆炸后约30亿年的宇宙时期，不是距离地球30亿光年。年轻恒星群支持磁星假说，但尚未确定具体机制。
泰国洪水遥感：NASA报道为2026-10-09；影像对比日期是2025-10-07与2026-10-02。假彩色并非人眼直接看到的颜色。本条仅使用NASA自身Landsat观测结论，不引用二手灾损数字，也不把此次洪水直接归因为厄尔尼诺。
